title: Correcting Diffusion Generation through Resampling
property: object presence (pretrained detector) plus real-versus-generated realism (trained discriminator)
reads: DETR-ResNet-50 on the one-step clean estimate f(X_t); discriminator on noisy X_t through SD 2.1-base U-Net down and middle blocks
trained_on: Detector pretrained; discriminators on 1M LAION Aesthetics real and 1M generated images, noised at uniform t, 2 epochs
gradient_enters: Proposed method uses no gradient: particles resampled by phi_t/phi_{t+1} six times at sigma <= 1.09; the D-Guidance baseline adds grad log(p/q) to the score only when sigma(t) < 5
unseen: no: every scored object belongs to the COCO categories the detector knows
headline: Object occurrence (0 to 1, higher better) on GPT-Synthetic, SD 2.1-base: plain SD 0.551, gradient D-Guidance 0.558, PF-Hybrid 0.744 at K=15 images, and detector-only best-of-15 also 0.744
copy_or_avoid: Put a best-of-K seed selection baseline in every comparison, because selection alone matches resampling at 0.744; do not cite this as proof gradients fail, since the gradient was off at sigma >= 5 (inferred)

extra_papers.title: Refining Generative Process with Discriminator Guidance in Score-Based Diffusion Models
extra_papers.why: Trains a real-versus-generated classifier across all concepts and adds its gradient to the score; this is the D-Guidance baseline

extra_papers.title: ImageReward: Learning and Evaluating Human Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation
extra_papers.why: Trains a human-preference scorer on generated images, a learned overall-match property, used here as a selection criterion

disagreements.claim: Resampling with the same signal reaches about 0.74
disagreements.paper_says: The 0.74 holds only at K=15 (0.689 at K=5, 0.733 at K=10). Object Select, which keeps the best of 15 finished images by detector score with no resampling, also reaches 0.744, and Table 2 gives best-of-K without resampling 67.16% against 72.96% with it. Most of the gain over plain SD comes from choosing among K images.

disagreements.claim: The test used a clean-image detector at low noise
disagreements.paper_says: The detector reads the one-step clean estimate f(X_t). The gradient runs for sigma(t) < 5, which on the paper's Eq. (24) schedule reaches t about 0.80 on a 0-to-1 scale, where x_t is about 0.196 x_0 + 0.981 noise (inferred arithmetic), so this is high noise. Low noise describes the resampling steps at sigma <= 1.09. The discriminator half of the signal is trained on noisy images.
